title: FollowUpDraft
description: A draft follow-up message (email, Slack, Jira comment, etc.) created by the agent or user after a task is marked done. Requires explicit user approval before any external send.

id.description: MongoDB ObjectId hex string (mapped from _id). Assigned by the server.

userId.description: Owning user ID. Sourced from the verified JWT — never from the client body.

taskId.description: ID of the Task document this follow-up is associated with.

channelType.description: Target channel for the follow-up message.

recipientOrTarget.description: Email address, Slack channel/user, or Jira issue key that is the send target. Treat as potentially sensitive PII.

subject.description: Subject line (used for email channel type).

body.description: Full message body. May contain sensitive operational context.

status.description: Lifecycle status. Only approved drafts may be sent externally, and only after explicit user action.

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 creation timestamp. Set by the server.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 last-update timestamp. Maintained by the server on every write.

approvedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the user approved this draft for external sending.
